_comment: Rule numbers for the traffic lights. 'amber' means yellow (Caution). At or above 'red' = red; at or above 'amber' = yellow.

rain_mm_per_hr._comment: Any rain the page shows (0.1 mm/hr or more) is amber.

lightning._comment: Never red: storms are too hard to forecast. Yellow ('Likely'): thunderstorm forecast during the session, or a BOM Severe Thunderstorm Warning (next 24 h). Yellow ('Possible'): BOM's day forecast mentions these words at a time that overlaps the session (see text_periods), or unstable air (CAPE) with rain.
lightning._comment_periods: If BOM's sentence names a time of day, only sessions overlapping these hours (local, start-end) are flagged. Afternoon runs to 7pm so storms lingering into an evening session still count. No time named = whole day.

visibility_m._comment: Yellow under 'amber'. A fog forecast (weather code, or 'fog' in BOM's text) only turns it yellow when there's no visibility number. The forecast is often wrong about fog, so it never goes red.

darkness._comment: Boat lights needed before sunrise and after sunset (sun centre 0.833° below the horizon, the standard sunrise/sunset definition). Shown as a 'Lights' note, not a light. Only turns things red in combinations that list it (currently none).

flow._comment: Estimated water speed at the course in km/h, river plus tide (scripts/flow_model.py). Also red for a BOM Maribyrnong Flood Warning, yellow for a Flood Watch (next 24 h), and yellow/red for an upstream gauge rising fast.

tide_level_m._comment: Tide height, its own light. Yellow when the forecast water level at Poyntons (course gauge 230106A datum) drops under 'amber' during the session: launching and landing are harder. -0.26 m is the lowest 5% of hourly gauge readings 2018-2026 (history/230106A_*); about 6% of sessions. Never red, and not in yellow_count_red.

yellow_count_red._comment: Overall goes red when this many of the listed lights are yellow at once.

_combinations_comment: When every factor in a combination is active (amber, or dark for darkness), those lights become red. Add your own.
